headline: CHC @ STL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHC 4.03 at STL 4.02, with a projected total of 8.05. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CHC: CHC moved +0.09 runs while STL moved -0.79, changing the projected margin by +0.88 runs. The projected total fell -0.69, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -20.0%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Matthew Liberatore has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Alex Bregman, Alec Burleson, JJ Wetherholt, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Nolan Gorman, Victor Scott II because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
